tasks.title: At the bakery: point, ask, thank
tasks.objective: Recognise a greeting, one object and a polite request, and reproduce the exchange with help.
tasks.context:
— Bonjour, madame. Une baguette, s’il vous plaît.
— Voilà.
— Merci. Au revoir !
— Au revoir !

Understand: Learn une baguette as a whole group: a baguette. S’il vous plaît makes this short request polite. Voilà accompanies handing something over here. First greet, then ask, then thank. Point to the phrase while listening. No analysis of every word is needed yet.

Language: Memorise une baguette and the request as chunks; do not generalise noun gender from this example.
